test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We have been __at fours and fives__ in the office due to network issues.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"at fours and fives" **is incorrect and not commonly used in English.
 
• The correct idiom is "**at sixes and sevens,"** which means in a state of confusion or disarray.
 
• This **idiom** aptly describes the situation in the office due to network issues.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We have been **at sixes and sevens** in the office due to network issues."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "At nines and tens" **– This is not a recognized idiom in English.
 
• **Option 3: "At threes and fours" **– This is also not a recognized idiom in English.
 
• **Option 4: "At eights and nines" **– This is not a recognized idiom in English either.
